summary: evidence-sign records runner nix for a nix build of a check derivation, and scripts/nix-check-facts writes the facts for it (output path, NAR hash, references, daemon signatures, cache hit)

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; CI configuration only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Nothing reads these records to skip a check; no policy names kinds.nix yet.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Required checks keep their names and outcomes. evidence-sign accepts one optional request key, runner, with the values wrapper (the default) and nix; every existing request is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; no nix record is published by anything yet.
